summary: This clinical trial compares adding the drug cofrogliptin versus increasing the dose of metformin in adults with type 2 diabetes, which is a condition where the body does not properly handle sugar in the blood. Participants in the study will have their blood sugar control, known as glycated hemoglobin levels, measured over time. The study is sponsored by the Second Affiliated Hospital, Zhejiang University, School of Medicine, and is currently recruiting 80 participants.
